envelope.description: Let the CLI's review read source roots through the daemon

body.title: Let the CLI's review read source roots through the daemon
body.summary: Add one optional reader field to the options of reviewArtifactFile, review and gatherEvidence and pass it down to resolveSourceRoots; add the read-only daemon request that returns a repository's entities for source roots; have the CLI's review pass a reader that calls it. State the fallback in the review's output when it is taken. The daemon's and the MCP server's callers pass nothing and are unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: A review run from the CLI's service against a daemon in a temporary home gets its source roots through the request, and the CLI's process holds no descriptor on the store file
With a reader that rejects, the review falls back to the repository root and its output says so and why
The daemon's own review and the MCP server's review step return what they returned before

tests.name: CLI review through the daemon: source roots come through the request and the CLI's process holds no descriptor on the store
CLI review: a rejecting reader falls back to the repository root and the output says so
review with no reader passed uses the default reader, as the daemon and the MCP server do
